items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue is evidenced only for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is reported as $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable. AI usage reports $886.12 across 4,865 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, but retained records conflict at $881.36 across 4,832 calls and $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Monthly spend, marketing, revenue, and floor limits are blank. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; retain operating metrics and CRO opportunities as deferred backlog, not financial returns. Minimum measurement: one reconciled AI-cost ledger; period-aligned site/content revenue by tracking ID; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, experiment, approved-budget, and learning-outcome costs for the same period; and a defined cost-to-learn threshold. No new queue work is financially supported.
